snippet.title: Civ Tour: Assyria | Civilization VII
snippet.description:
From Mesopotamia, to military mastery, rule astutely as ASSYRIA.

Add the Assyria civilization to your collection for the Antiquity Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII as part of the paid Right to Rule Collection DLC!*

► Get Civ 7 today: https://2kgam.es/Civ7
► Link your 2K Account to unlock Napoleon in Civ 7: https://2kgam.es/Napoleon
► Visit the Game Guide for more on each leader and civ: https://2kgam.es/Civ7GameGuide

---------------------------------
HISTORY
---------------------------------
Nestled in the Fertile Crescent, Assyria was one of the earliest states to dominate the region. From beginnings in the city of Ashur to the rise of the great Neo-Assyrian Empire, a long succession of kings would oversee the bloody conquest of Babylon, Egypt, and others – acting as a conduit for Mesopotamian culture throughout the lands. These conquests would later spell doom for Assyria, as a Babylonian revolt ended the empire in 609 BCE.

---------------------------------
ABILITY
---------------------------------
Treasures of Nineveh: Gain a Technology upon capturing a Settlement for the first time. Codices are not awarded from Technologies.

---------------------------------
ATTRIBUTES
---------------------------------
- Militaristic
- Scientific

---------------------------------
CIVIC TREES
---------------------------------
Birtūtu
- Tier 1: Unlocks the Citadel Unique Building and Dur-Sharrukin Wonder. Increased Culture for each Technology Mastery in the Capital. Increased Settlement Limit.
- Tier 2: Combat Units receive increased Combat Strength when defending against Ranged Units. Unlocks the 'Dūrāni' Tradition. Gain a Codex.
- Tradition - Dūrāni: Increased Science on Fortification Buildings. 

Tupšarrūtu
- Tier 1: Unlocks the Royal Library Unique Building and the Turtanu Unique Commander Unit. When you capture a Settlement for the first time, gain a Codex.
- Tier 2: Increased Happiness to Science Buildings. Unlocks the 'Miḫiṣtu' Tradition. Gain a Codex.
- Tradition - Miḫiṣtu: Increased Production towards Buildings and Wonders with a Great Work Slot. 

Kibrāt Arba’i
- Tier 1: Increased Settlement Limit. Increased Combat Strength to Magarru Unique Cavalry Units if they are in a Command Radius.
- Tier 2: Increased Science in Cities not founded by you. Unlocks the 'Girru' Tradition. Gain a Codex.
- Tradition - Girru: Increased Production and Food in Settlements not founded by you.

---------------------------------
INFRASTRUCTURE
---------------------------------
Ekallu: Unique Quarter. Increased Production for each Great Work in this City.

Royal Library: Science Base. Has multiple Codex Slots. Gain Science adjacency bonus with Rivers and Mountain tiles.

Citadel: Production Base. Counts as a Fortification. Increased Happiness if built on a Flat tile.

---------------------------------
CIVILIAN UNIT
---------------------------------
Turtanu: Unique Commander Unit. Melee and Cavalry Units within the Command Radius have increased Combat Strength against Districts.

---------------------------------
MILITARY UNIT
---------------------------------
Magarru: Unique Cavalry Unit. Has increased Movement. Can move after attacking and ignores Zone of Control.

---------------------------------
WONDER
---------------------------------
Dur-Sharrukin: Acts as a Fortified District that must be conquered. Increased Combat Strength to Fortified Districts in all Settlements. This Wonder is available in the base game. 

---------------------------------
STARTING BIAS
---------------------------------
- Flat
- Rivers

---------------------------------
GAMEPLAY TIP
---------------------------------
Technology Masteries may not grant Assyria Codices, but they will grant Culture with the Birtūtu Civic. Unlock the Tupšarrūtu Civic quickly to get Codices from conquering Settlements instead!

*Assyria civilization is part of the Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Right to Rule Collection DLC. Right to Rule Collection is included in the Founders Edition of Sid Meier's Civilization® VII. It is also available for separate purchase (base game required).
